title: CreeperSafe
description: A lightweight Paper plugin for creeper blast protection that stops block and item griefing while keeping normal explosion damage.
body:
# 🚀 CreeperSafe > Stop creeper griefing without losing the danger. **CreeperSafe** is a lightweight, performance-focused Paper plugin that protects your builds and terrain from creeper explosions. Keep creepers dangerous! Players and mobs will still take full damage from explosions, but your blocks, chest contents, and dropped ground items **remain completely safe.** --- ## ✨ Features ### 🛡️ Terrain & Build Protection - **Anti-Grief Blast Protection:** Prevents creeper explosions from breaking blocks. - **Item Protection:** Ensures dropped ground items are not vaporized by the blast. - **Dangerous Blast Damage:** Keeps the vanilla explosion damage to players and mobs, preserving survival difficulty. --- ## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions > 💡 **Tip:** You can use either `/creepersafe` or the shorter alias `/cs` for all commands. * 💻 `/cs help` — Shows grouped help and usage examples. * 📊 `/cs status` — Shows if creeper destruction is currently enabled or disabled. * 💥 `/cs creeperDestruction ` — Enables or disables creeper block and item destruction. * ⚙️ `/cs reload` — Reloads the plugin configuration file (`config.yml`). - Admin commands require: `creepersafe.admin` (Granted to OP by default) - Player commands require: `creepersafe.command` (Granted to OP by default) --- ## ⚙️ Default Configuration
📄 Click to view the default config.yml ```yaml # SimpleCreeperSafe Configuration File version: 1.0 creeper-explosions: block-damage-enabled: false ```
--- ## 📦 Installation 1. Download the latest `.jar` file from the **Versions** tab. 2. Drop it into your Paper server's `plugins` folder. 3. Restart your server. 4. Configure settings in-game via command or inside `plugins/CreeperSafe/config.yml`. --- ## 💜 Support & Suggest Features If CreeperSafe helped improve your server, consider supporting the development! - **💰 Support & Pitch an Idea:** You can make a donation via [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=TANK86W7A2RBS). Have a feature idea? Leave a suggestion in your donation note! - **💬 Discord Community:** Official Discord server prepared for support and discussions. Join: [Discord Club](https://discord.gg/gBNzfRTYrF)!
